en: Job 14

p.src: 1  “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

en: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
u.src: 1  “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

p.src: 2  He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

en: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
u.src: 2  He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

p.src: 3  Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?

en: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?
u.src: 3  Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?

p.src: 4  Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
u.src: 4  Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

p.src: 5  Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.

en: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.
u.src: 5  Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.

p.src: 6  Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.

en: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.
u.src: 6  Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.

p.src: 7  “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

en: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.
u.src: 7  “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

p.src: 8  Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

en: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,
u.src: 8  Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

p.src: 9  yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.

en: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.
u.src: 9  yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.

p.src: 10  But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

en: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?
u.src: 10  But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

p.src: 11  As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,

en: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,
u.src: 11  As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,

p.src: 12  so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

en: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
u.src: 12  so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

p.src: 13  “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!

en: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!
u.src: 13  “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!

en: 14:13 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 14  If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.

en: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
u.src: 14  If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.

p.src: 15  You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.

en: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.
u.src: 15  You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.

p.src: 16  But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?

en: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
u.src: 16  But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?

p.src: 17  My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

en: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.
u.src: 17  My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

p.src: 18  “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.

en: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.
u.src: 18  “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.

p.src: 19  The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

en: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.
u.src: 19  The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

p.src: 20  You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.

en: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.
u.src: 20  You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.

p.src: 21  His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

en: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.
u.src: 21  His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

p.src: 22  But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”

en: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”
u.src: 22  But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”
